appName.message: StreamMask – Hide Personal Info While Streaming

appDesc.message: For streamers: masks phone numbers, e-mails, IDs, IBANs, cards, IPs and API keys with *****. Stream Mode hides history suggestions.

maskedNone.message: No personal info found on this page

autoSub.message: No setup needed: anything that looks like personal info becomes *****

alsoSub.message: Your name, street, username… type and press Enter

wordHint.message: 🔒 Don't type numbers, cards, IBANs or e-mails: they are caught automatically. This list stays on this device only and is never sent anywhere.

wordWarn.message: Don't type numbers, cards, IBANs or e-mails: they are caught automatically and never saved here.

streamSub.message: Hides history suggestions in the address bar

streamOff.message: Off. When on, your history is backed up inside the extension and removed from suggestions; it comes back when you turn it off. Nothing is deleted.

streamOn.message: $COUNT$ history entries kept safe, turned on $AGO$ ago.

streamOn2.message: Search suggestions and autofill are off too.

blockSub.message: Tabs with these sites are closed the moment Stream Mode turns on, and again if they open during the stream

blockedPageText.message: This site is on your Stream Mode block list. Turn Stream Mode off to open it.

streamErrorBackup.message: Backup missing: Stream Mode is on, but the saved history could not be found. Turning it off restores suggestions and autofill, but the earlier history cannot be brought back.

backupReminder.message: Tip: download the JSON backup now. If the extension is removed while Stream Mode is on, the history cannot be restored.

maskStyleHint.message: Same length keeps the page layout from shifting. Last 4 never applies to API keys or your custom words.

idRegionSub.message: Only the selected countries’ ID formats are checked. Fewer countries means fewer false positives.

obsSub.message: Protection turns on by itself when you go live

obsHelp.message: In OBS: Tools → WebSocket Server Settings → enable the server, then copy the port and password from there. Nothing leaves your computer.

obsStatusFail.message: OBS not reachable — is the WebSocket server on?

obsRevert.message: Restore the old state when it ends

bridgeSub.message: One switch for the app and the browser

bridgePush.message: Send Stream Mode to the app too

bridgeHelp.message: In StreamMask Desktop: Browser extension bridge → copy the pairing code. The connection stays on this computer.

labelHint.message: Masks the value next to a label, even when it matches no pattern: "Address: …", "Date of birth: …", "Order no: …". Off by default, because it can hide more of a page than you expect.

obsStatusAuthSkipped.message: Not OBS: no password was asked for
